top_skills.name: Claude Skill Registry
top_skills.why_valuable: It is the most comprehensive, dedicated community registry specifically built for Claude Code skills.
top_skills.description: A centralized repository acting as a directory for discovering, sharing, and organizing Claude Code skills and MCP converters.

top_skills.name: SkillsHub
top_skills.why_valuable: Provides massive scale and discoverability with over 5,000 AI agent skills aggregated from hundreds of top repositories.
top_skills.description: An AI agent skills registry designed for token-efficient skill resolution via a single API call, supporting various markdown and agent formats.

top_skills.name: Claude Code Builder
top_skills.why_valuable: Offers dedicated tooling and command templates specifically designed to help developers build and scaffold their own Claude Code skills.
top_skills.description: A utility toolkit containing commands (like `create-skill`) to streamline the development and structuring of custom Claude capabilities.

top_skills.name: ACPlugin (Converter)
top_skills.why_valuable: Breaks down walled gardens by allowing you to port skills written for Claude Code to other popular AI coding environments, and vice versa.
top_skills.description: A conversion tool designed to translate and port Claude Code plugins/skills into Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor compatible formats.

top_skills.name: AGENTS.md Standards
top_skills.why_valuable: Focuses on standardization across projects, ensuring that AI agents (like Claude) can seamlessly read context and collaborate when entering a new repository.
top_skills.description: Provides initialization scripts and skills to set up projects with the AGENTS.md 1.1 standard for better AI context management.

notes: The filtering prioritized repositories that are explicitly designed as platforms, directories, or utilities for Claude Code and general AI Agent workflows over highly specific, single-use repositories (like specific Android or PineScript repos).
